results.redactedSql:
WITH period_consumption AS (
  SELECT
    m.product_id,
    m.product_name,
    m.sku,
    SUM(ABS(m.quantity)) AS consumed_quantity
  FROM agent_v3_stock_movement_view AS m
  WHERE m.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
    AND m.occurred_at >= :startAt::timestamptz
    AND m.occurred_at < :endAt::timestamptz
    AND m.quantity < 0
    AND m.product_name ILIKE '***'
  GROUP BY m.product_id, m.product_name, m.sku
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  p.sku,
  COALESCE(MAX(pc.consumed_quantity), 0) AS consumed_quantity,
  MAX(p.current_stock) AS current_stock
FROM agent_v3_product_inventory_view AS p
LEFT JOIN period_consumption AS pc
  ON pc.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.store_id = ANY(:allowedStoreIds)
  AND p.product_name ILIKE '***'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.sku
LIMIT 100;
